HediffDef.label: Rapid Mimic Pursuit
HediffDef.description: During Form I after breaching containment, Nothing There sprints at twice its normal pursuit speed before entering metamorphosis.

HediffDef.label: True Form Awakening
HediffDef.description: Nothing There has shed its shell and awakened its True Form, surging with terrifying speed and lethality while becoming immune to Red trauma.

HediffDef.label: Mimicry Regeneration
HediffDef.description: The living flesh of the Mimicry E.G.O Suit continuously knits its wearer's torn tissues back together.
